question: The ________ port was developed after Independence to ease the volume of trade on the Mumbai port.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kandla**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kandla** port was developed after Independence to ease the volume of trade on the Mumbai port.
 
• Kandla is one of the major ports on the west coast of India and is located in the Kutch district of Gujarat.
 
• It was the first Special Economic Zone (SEZ) established in India.
